name.local: स्टार्टअप के लिए फंड ऑफ फंड्स

aka: SIDBI Fund of Funds for Startups

strategy.lead_or_follow: fund-of-funds (invests in AIFs, not directly in startups)
strategy.thesis: Government fund-of-funds that does not invest directly in startups; it commits capital to SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (daughter funds), which in turn invest at least twice the FFS contribution into Indian startups. Implemented by SIDBI. FoF 2.0 prioritises deep tech, manufacturing and smaller/early-growth AIFs.

application.how_to_apply: AIFs (not startups) apply to SIDBI to receive FFS commitments; startups raise from the AIFs that FFS backs.

summary.en: India's flagship government fund-of-funds, announced in the Startup India Action Plan (2016) with a ₹10,000 crore corpus managed by SIDBI. It invests in SEBI-registered AIFs rather than startups directly. A second tranche, Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 (₹10,000 crore), was notified in 2025 with a focus on deep tech and manufacturing.
summary.local: स्टार्टअप इंडिया एक्शन प्लान (2016) के तहत ₹10,000 करोड़ के कोष वाला भारत सरकार का प्रमुख फंड ऑफ फंड्स, जिसका प्रबंधन SIDBI करता है।

strategy.thesis: DPIIT scheme that channels seed capital to early-stage DPIIT-recognised startups through a network of ~300 approved incubators, which evaluate applications and disburse funds. Grants for proof of concept/prototype/product trials; convertible-debenture/debt investment for market entry, commercialisation and scale-up.

investment.raw: up to ₹50 lakh per startup (plus up to ₹20 lakh grant)

program.eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago at time of application; Indian-promoter majority; not received >₹10 lakh other monetary support (excl. prize money/competitions).

application.how_to_apply: Apply on the Startup India Seed Fund portal selecting up to 3 incubators; the incubator's Selection Committee evaluates and disburses.

summary.en: A ₹945 crore DPIIT scheme (2021) providing seed capital to early-stage startups via ~300 approved incubators: up to ₹20 lakh grant for proof of concept/prototype and up to ₹50 lakh for commercialisation through convertible debentures or debt.

Establishes and funds Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) at universities/institutions/corporates — each AIC eligible for up to ₹10 crore grant over five years — plus Atal Tinkering Labs in schools and Atal Community Innovation Centres (up to ₹2.5 crore on matching basis).

name.en: NIDHI — National Initiative for Developing and Harnessing Innovations (DST)

strategy.thesis: Umbrella programme of the Department of Science & Technology (NSTEDB) to nurture knowledge-based and technology-driven ideas into startups. Components include NIDHI-PRAYAS (idea-to-prototype, up to ₹10 lakh per innovator), NIDHI-Seed Support System, NIDHI Technology Business Incubators (TBI/iTBI) and Centres of Excellence — a network of 160+ TBIs.

program.eligibility: Innovators/early-stage startups with technology-driven ideas hosted at NIDHI/DST incubators.

summary.en: An umbrella programme of the Department of Science & Technology (NSTEDB) supporting tech-driven startups from idea to scale through NIDHI-PRAYAS (up to ₹10 lakh/innovator), Seed Support System, and a network of 160+ Technology Business Incubators and 8 Centres of Excellence.

name.local: स्टार्टअप के लिए ऋण गारंटी योजना

check_size.raw: guarantee cover up to ₹20 crore per borrower

strategy.thesis: DPIIT credit-guarantee scheme operationalised by NCGTC. It provides credit guarantee cover (not direct funding) to Member Institutions (banks/NBFCs/AIFs) lending to DPIIT-recognised startups via venture debt, working capital and other debt instruments. Guarantee ceiling raised from ₹10 crore to ₹20 crore per borrower.

investment.raw: guarantee cover up to ₹20 crore per borrower (85% of default up to ₹10 crore; 75% above)

program.format: guarantee cover via NCGTC to Member Institutions
program.eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startups not in default and not classified as NPA per RBI guidelines.

application.how_to_apply: Startups borrow from Member Institutions (banks/NBFCs/AIFs) who avail guarantee cover from NCGTC.

summary.en: A DPIIT credit-guarantee scheme (2022) operationalised by NCGTC that backs loans (venture debt, working capital, etc.) to DPIIT-recognised startups. It provides guarantee cover to lending Member Institutions, with the per-borrower ceiling raised from ₹10 crore to ₹20 crore.
summary.local: DPIIT की ऋण गारंटी योजना (2022) जो NCGTC के माध्यम से DPIIT-मान्यता प्राप्त स्टार्टअप को दिए गए ऋणों पर गारंटी कवर देती है।

strategy.thesis: Government scheme facilitating collateral-free composite bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities. Backed by the Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India (CGFSI).

investment.raw: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore composite bank loan (debt, not equity)

program.format: bank loans via scheduled commercial banks
program.eligibility: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs (18+) setting up a greenfield enterprise; for non-individual enterprises, 51%+ held by SC/ST/woman.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the Stand-Up India (standupmitra) portal or directly at bank branches.

summary.en: A 2016 Government of India scheme facilitating collateral-free composite bank loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises. As of Oct 2025 banks had sanctioned ~₹62,807 crore to ~275,321 beneficiaries. It is debt finance (not equity).
